select u.* from sys_user u
order by u.id desc limit #{limit}

select distinct r.code as roleCode, sr.permission from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id and r.deleted = 0 and r.status = '1' left join sys_role_res rr on rr.role_id = r.id and rr.deleted = 0 left join sys_res sr on sr.id = rr.res_id and sr.deleted = 0 and sr.status = '1' and sr.permission is not null and sr.permission != '' where ur.deleted = 0 and ur.user_id = #{userId}
